Scotland fans in Boston for the World Cup have been placing orange traffic cones on statues, a tradition originating in Glasgow. While authorities initially removed them, the fans continue the practice as a friendly gesture.

The Bright Side:
The genuine curiosity and amusement of Bostonians, who are embracing the 'Tartan Army's' quirky tradition as a symbol of the city's international visitors.
